'''Immunity to attrition''' protects a character, vehicle or starship from varying levels of [[attrition]], as listed on the card (for example "immune to attrition < 5"). A player satisfying attrition does not have to forfeit a card with this immunity unless the total attrition reaches its immunity level.<ref name="gl20">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Glossary, Version 2.0], Decipher (November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081221001241/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Internet Archive]. Wiki transcription: [[Decipher Glossary 2.0]]</ref>

Immunity is compared only against total attrition, not against what remains after other forfeits. An enclosed vehicle or starship with immunity protects itself and all cards aboard. Immunity is not cumulative: a card with immunity from several sources uses only the highest. An immune card may still be forfeited voluntarily.<ref name="gl20" />

== Example ==
Darth Vader (immune to attrition < 5) and a Stormtrooper (forfeit 2) are in a battle with attrition 4. Vader is protected, but the Stormtrooper must be forfeited. With attrition of 5 or more, Vader is no longer protected.<ref name="gl20" />
